i001-line-highest-at-floor.description: Select the highest revision on the required line at or above the floor, skipping a higher revision on another line.

i002-sticky-default-other-line.description: A sticky default on another line fails instead of falling back to the required line.

i003-sticky-default-on-line.description: Honor a sticky default on the required line despite a newer revision on that line.

i004-sticky-default-below-floor.description: A sticky default on the required line but below the floor fails.

i005-floor-without-line.description: A floor without a compatibility line does not select an Incremental target.

i006-no-requirement.description: An unpinned reference to an Incremental target needs a compatibility line.

i007-legacy-floor-on-incremental-target.description: A SemVer floor term on a reference to an Incremental target is rejected.

i008-noncanonical-floor.description: An Incremental floor with a leading zero is not a canonical revision.

i009-relative-line.description: A compatibility line that is not an absolute IRI is rejected.

i010-unknown-profile.description: A target whose profile is not known from trusted metadata is not resolved.

i011-no-revision-on-line.description: No revision on the required line fails without trying another line.

i012-lineless-revision-excluded.description: A Version without a line is not eligible for live selection.

i013-generated-revision-satisfies-floor.description: A generated revision is an ordinary revision and satisfies a floor.

i014-semver-uav-floor.description: On a SemVer target, uav:minVersion replaces tm:minVersion with the same meaning.

i015-semver-uav-beside-legacy-floor.description: uav:minVersion beside tm:minVersion is rejected even when the values agree.

i016-semver-target-with-line.description: A compatibility line on a reference to a SemVer target is rejected.

i017-semver-td-uav-floor-major-cap.description: On a SemVer TD target, uav:minVersion acts as td:minVersion and keeps the major cap.

i020-replay-digest-duplicate-highest.description: Raw exact replay of duplicate bytes returns the highest revision and checks no requirement.

i021-replay-versionid-other-line.description: Raw exact replay returns the pinned Version even when it is on another line.

i022-compose-bound-lower-revision.description: Snapshot-bound composition uses the bound revision, not the newest one on the line.

i023-compose-bound-other-line.description: A binding to another line fails the requirement check and does not fall back.

i024-compose-missing-binding.description: A required reference without a binding leaves the closure incomplete.

i025-compose-bound-below-floor.description: A bound revision below the floor fails the requirement check.

i026-compose-binding-digest-mismatch.description: A binding whose digest differs from the captured Version leaves the closure incomplete.

i030-local-containing-revision.description: A local reference checks the containing revision and line, not a newer revision.

i031-local-below-floor.description: A local reference fails when the containing revision is below its floor.

i032-local-lineless-containing-revision.description: A local reference fails when the containing revision has no line.

i040-publish-authored-above-mark.description: An authored canonical revision above the high-water mark becomes the versionid.

i041-publish-authored-at-mark.description: An authored revision at the high-water mark is rejected.

i042-publish-semver-string-generated.description: A SemVer authored value is not interpreted; the registry assigns the next integer.

i043-publish-mark-survives-deletion.description: Deleted revisions are not reused; the ancestor is the highest existing revision.

i044-publish-first-revision.description: The first revision is 1 and is its own ancestor.

i045-publish-line-conflict.description: Root line and creation metadata that disagree are rejected.

i046-publish-supplied-versionid-mismatch.description: A supplied versionid that differs from the assignment is rejected.

i047-publish-supplied-versionid-noncanon.description: A supplied versionid with a leading zero is rejected.

i048-publish-root-line-in-semver-registr.description: A root compatibility line in a SemVer registry is rejected.

i049-publish-relative-line.description: A root line that is not an absolute IRI is rejected.

i050-publish-ancestor-mismatch.description: A supplied ancestorid other than the highest existing revision is rejected.

i051-publish-matching-lines.description: Equal root and metadata lines are recorded once.

i060-update-changes-line.description: A request that changes a Version's line is rejected.

i061-update-adds-line.description: A line cannot be added to a Version created without one.

i062-update-keeps-line.description: Repeating the existing line is accepted.
